caption: Three folders are private. The plugin wrote their deny rules at once.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['agent-rules']; for (let i = 0; i < 8 && document.querySelector('.modal-container'); i++) { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', keyCode: 27, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } if (document.querySelector('.modal-container')) throw new Error('a modal stays open'); p.settings.privateFolders = []; await p.writePrivateRules(false); app.workspace.rightSplit.setSize(560); const v = await p.activateView(); v.selected = null; p.lastLint = null; v.render(); p.settings.privateFolders = ['Agent Rules/Clients', 'Agent Rules/Health', 'Agent Rules/Journal']; await p.saveSettings(); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach((n) => n.remove()); await p.writePrivateRules(true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const s = JSON.parse(await app.vault.adapter.read('.claude/settings.json')); for (const f of ['Journal', 'Health', 'Clients']) for (const k of ['Read', 'Edit']) if (!s.permissions.deny.includes(k + '(/Agent Rules/' + f + '/**)')) throw new Error('missing deny rule ' + k + ' ' + f); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.agent-rules-list li span')].map((e) => e.textContent); if (items.length !== 3) throw new Error('view shows ' + items.join(', ')); return 'private folders PASS'; })()
